page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. The configuration includes 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a strong single-core capability, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance is comparatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for large blocks is average, but small-block cached read bandwidth is weak. Database operations and static web serving throughput are poor, placing in the bottom 10% of benchmarked systems.

The instance offers a balanced resource profile suitable for entry-level general-purpose workloads. Given its dedicated CPU allocation and strong single-core performance, it is qualitatively cost-efficient for tasks that do not require massive parallel processing or high-throughput database operations. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage. It is best suited for lightweight applications, single-threaded processing tasks, basic text processing, and low-traffic web serving.
